facts.label: Festivais de rua
facts.sub: Cidades americanas fecham ruas inteiras para festivais com música, barracas de comida e artesanato. Muita gente passeia a pé, prova comidas diferentes e conversa com os vizinhos.

facts.label: Bandas ao vivo
facts.sub: Em festivais, bandas locais tocam em pequenos palcos. O estilo varia: folk, jazz, rock, mariachi. A plateia fica em pé, dança e aplaude, e o show costuma ser gratuito.

compare.us: In the USA, street festivals close the street and have stages, stalls and sometimes a parade.

pages.title: Tamales and confetti · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening, and the plaza in San Antonio is full of people. Colorful flags hang above the street. Ana walks slowly and listens to the music. Children run with red and yellow balloons. A woman named Rosa stands near a small stage. She smiles and waves at Ana.
“Hello! Are you enjoying the festival?” says Rosa. “Yes! The music is great. Is that a brass band?” says Ana. “No, it is a folk band. Look, there is an accordion.” says Rosa.
